scope: Isolated opt-in reusable-sync-103 correctness/recovery only; no performance cohort or adoption.
hypothesis: One lazy owned bounded sync worker per Archive preserves the 101 overlap while avoiding a fresh thread per publication. Speed remains a future testable hypothesis.
contracts: Normal and 101 publication function bodies remain byte-exact. No supported engine changes.
Same original File transferred after all segment bytes are flushed; no unsafe or OS handle duplication.
Private zero-capacity request channel, capacity-one completion channel, checked ticket and at most one job.
Both original sync_all calls complete successfully before unchanged catalog rename and ACK.
Catalog unwind always waits for actual job completion; worker sync unwind becomes unknown-outcome error.
Disconnect, handoff failure, mismatched reply, sync error and panic close admission and join before error return.
Idle worker retains no segment File; Archive stop/drop joins the real thread before dropping its lease.
Archive and ArchiveSnapshot retain Send/Sync. Existing reclaimer, formats, receipts, source, pins and budgets unchanged.
The legacy sync_joined external fault label means received job completion in 103; no test event calls job completion thread exit.
Overlapping wall clocks are not exclusive CPU/IO attribution. No new dependency or version bump.
fresh_build_requirements: Normal, existing101 and new103 debug/release; 103 profile debug/release and combined fault suite; strict all-target default/normal/101/103/profile/combined lints. Offline locked fresh D targets, independent test roots and all stores/logs retained.
